Subscript rendered with tilde symbol

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import ConversionOptions, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>H<sub>2</sub>O</p>"
    options = ConversionOptions(sub_symbol="~")
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
